summary: A visitor died by suicide in Colorado National Monument; NPS reported it as one of three visitor fatalities in September 2013 (the Sept 18 accidental ~400-ft fall near Cold Shivers Point Overlook and a Sept 18/19 single-vehicle accident), noting the park worked with the Mesa County Sheriff's Department on body recoveries
responding_agency: National Park Service; Mesa County Sheriff's Department
notes: NPS Sept 24, 2013 incident report; specific location within the park not given; distinct from id 2785 (2013-09-18 accidental Cold Shivers Point fall)
